content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
I dream earthquakes before they happen. Last night I saw a 4.0 and this morning there was one.
I can’t verify predictive ability from one instance. Did you have a dated note of the dream before the quake report?
I texted a friend at 2 a.m. describing it.
A timestamped record is useful. Over time, scoring predictions for location, magnitude, and time window quantifies accuracy versus chance.
How precise should the window be?
Defining it in advance—like magnitude ±0.5 and within 24 hours—lets you evaluate hits and misses consistently.
Then the score would reflect that trend and could be compared to a baseline of generic predictions.
